I am excited to explore new ideas, learn new things, and contribute to the NASA Space Apps Challenge. I believe in creativity, curiosity, and teamwork. My goal is to learn, grow, and make something meaningful. Let's reach for the stars! 🚀"
summary: Galaxy Mind is an interactive space exploration project designed to help students understand the challenges of building and managing a sustainable lunar or Martian outpost. It focuses on important mission requirements such as life support, radiation protection, power management, and food production. Through an engaging and educational experience, users can explore different decisions, balance limited resources, and understand how their choices affect the success of a space mission. The goal is to make space science, engineering, and problem-solving more interesting and accessible to everyone.
details: Galaxy Mind is an educational space exploration project that focuses on the challenges of building a sustainable outpost on the Moon or Mars. The project explores four major areas: life support, radiation protection, power management, and food production. It includes an interactive simulation where users can adjust resources and check their mission readiness. The goal is to help students understand how astronauts and engineers make important decisions when resources are limited. Developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, Galaxy Mind makes space science more interactive, creative, and enjoyable. Our vision is to inspire curiosity, encourage problem-solving, and help people understand the future of human space exploration.
